master.prompt: Identity-preserve industrial design correction for THE HUMAN TOUCH. Create one landscape studio master sheet: left TRUE STRAIGHT FRONT and right rear three-quarter, two full-height views of exactly the same female robot. Inputs, priority: Image 1 original Parian is the EXACT primary source of the FRONT appearance, face, shoulder span, waist, hip width, long arms, thigh contours and leg lengths; Image 2 supplies ONLY the open-back titanium spinal mechanics and rear thigh/calf tendons. Maintain original 01 Parian's graceful feminine body and natural classical proportions, calmly squared and axially aligned. NEW MANUFACTURING REQUIREMENT: the ENTIRE FRONT of the robot from collarbones across breastplate and abdomen down to the pelvis is a single continuously formed, unblemished ivory shell with a perfectly smooth, BILATERALLY SYMMETRICAL surface. NO center seam, NO off-center curved seam, NO cracks, NO marble veins, NO diagonal lines, no scoring, no stained streak, no faux kintsugi. The left and right sides of the front body have identical geometry. Face and head also have symmetrical shapes. Ivory surface is a solid-color satin technical ceramic that holds the light like honed white marble. Keep only joints required for motion at shoulders, elbows, wrists, hip sockets, knees, and ankles. Preserve Parian's human-shaped serene female face and bald sculpted crown. Open rear running from nape through pelvis with exposed metal segments and open leg mechanics as shown in image 2; frontal ivory thigh and shin faces remain smooth and symmetrical. Pair of identical, equal-height full-body figures centered separately, full feet in frame, relaxed LOW A-pose with arms slightly apart, clear spaces around both figures and around hands and legs, soft neutral photographic light on neutral warm grey. Level orthographic catalogue perspective, no words, no floor markings, no extra figures. It must read as a photoreal beautifully crafted service machine. Keep anatomical front pelvic form simple. Highest priority final design adjustment: The hero is subtly ANDROGYNOUS with a feminine silhouette. Chest is a shallow broad continuous smooth convex ceramic casing like a designer mannequin, with barely perceptible pectoral contours and an unbroken, featureless front surface. No anatomical breasts, nipples, bumps, dots, areolas or cleavage. Front pelvic shell and abdomen are smooth and manufactured, no navel. Keep original shoulder span and softly feminine waist and hips, long slender limbs; serene slightly androgynous original 01 face.

exhibits.prompt: Use case: compositing. Create a widescreen 16:9 Renaissance museum exhibition image inspired by the fingertip gesture in the supplied detail from The Creation of Adam. Reference 1 supplies only the arrangement of the two reaching hands. Reference 2 is the actual photoreal industrial robot Parian in profile. Reference 3 fixes her facial design. On the left, the painted figure of Adam is a fully clothed adult in a long, richly folded ochre and blue Renaissance tunic, leaning forward from a ridge and extending his hand. On the right, the single ivory and bronze service robot reaches one ivory index finger toward his, creating a slim, clearly legible gap in the middle of the frame. Match the robot's smooth ivory unmarked symmetric ceramic chassis, sculpted bald face, fine metal joints and human scale. Her product-photographic surfaces reflect the warm light. Behind the pair and around the edges, depict a wide monumental fresco of a fictional war between humans in colored tunics and mechanical soldiers. Discarded shields, torn standards, a broken city and distant smoke, turbulent cloud shapes; a quiet pocket of clear warm sky behind the fingertips. Every human figure is fully clothed. Show the whole scene, keep the huge central gesture distinct from the many small background figures, compose the fingers near the frame center. Painted mineral pigments and worn plaster cover every element of the scene except the foreground robot. No captions, type, borders, logos or graphic injuries.
